_comment: ScrollKiller guilt pack. Bundled in assets/ today; the shape is deliberately the one a
server would return so a future /guilt_pack fetch can hot-swap it with no app update.
See docs/DECISIONS.md D9, D33, D41, D42, D43.
NO GUILT LINE MAY EVER BE HARD-CODED IN KOTLIN. The only strings in code are the three
in GuiltPack.FALLBACK, which exist solely so a broken build does not render a blank
screen. Every line the user actually sees comes from this file.
Contract the loader enforces (GuiltPackParser):
schema_version   int  — loader REJECTS anything it doesn't know and keeps the pack it
already has. Currently 2 (v1 had no intensity/lang/region).
revision         int  — monotonic content version. A remote pack must have a HIGHER
revision than the installed one to replace it (stale-write guard).
lang / region    str  — the pack's DEFAULT audience. Every line inherits these unless it
overrides them, so one file can carry several audiences and adding
one is a JSON drop, not an engine change (D43).
lines[].id       str  — STABLE and unique. It keys the session no-repeat rotation AND the
daily deck shuffle, so reusing an id for different text makes a
line look 'already seen'.
lines[].intensity int — 1..4. WHEN the line may appear, mapped to today's TOTAL count by
GuiltTier. Below 50 the app shows NO line at all.
1  50-69    mild, playful nudge
2  70-99    cheeky roast
3  100-149  real guilt, harder roast
4  150+     maximum guilt (still funny — see D9)
Thresholds live in GuiltThresholds, not here; this field only says
how hard a line hits, never at what count.
lines[].weight   int  — relative pick odds within the eligible pool. >=1. A line at
weight 4 is twice as likely as one at weight 2.
lines[].category str  — must be one of the four below; a line with an unknown category
is DROPPED, not fatal, so a newer server pack degrades gracefully
on an older client.
surfaces         map  — which categories each render surface may draw from. This is the
tone policy, and living in the pack means it is remotely tunable
too. Unknown surface keys are ignored; a known surface missing
here falls back to all categories.
Categories:
roast          — playful mockery. The default voice.
existential    — the heavier time-is-finite register. Used sparingly.
reverse_psych  — gives permission to continue, so continuing feels like a choice.
pride          — encouragement for stopping. D9: mixing these in is what keeps the app
from being a shame machine people uninstall. Never remove the category,
and note it carries lines at EVERY intensity — at 200 reels the way out
still has to exist.
Authoring rules for this pack (voice: India, Gen-Z English):
- Keep lines short. They render in a ~240dp overlay panel over someone's video.
- Escalate the CONTENT, not the volume. Tier 4 is savage, never cruel: no body, family,
money, grades or mental-health jabs. If a line would make someone uninstall out of
shame rather than laugh and stop, it is the wrong line (D9).
- Roughly 18 lines per intensity so the daily deck (GuiltDeck, 60% of the pool) has room
to rotate. The pack can grow to hundreds with no code change.
